name: InfluxDB
overview: A popular, high-performance time-series database with a strong ecosystem and real-time analytics capabilities.
details: InfluxDB excels in scenarios requiring complex downsampling and real-time data transformations via its Flux language.
While slightly heavier than VictoriaMetrics, it is deeply integrated into many IoT and home automation workflows, making it a viable Tier 1 alternative for users with existing InfluxData ecosystems.
